# Cycle19 algorithms and complexity refresh

Worker: metric_acquisition, verified GPT-6.1 Sol/max. Pinned release commit: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`. No nested workers, paid services, contacts, publication, commits, old-cycle edits or upstream repository-program execution.

The strongest result is a complete, independently reconstructed replication lemma from the general-graph matching manuscript: a stationary pair update need only control **every additive pair observable**, rather than have a full pair gap. With q>=16C copies at each tier, charged base refresh, and lazy scan of M=Tq²+q updates, the full product gap is at least3/(8M). Root's independent proof gate passes. This is a reusable theoretical module; the release's full matching FPRAS remains unvalidated by this scoped audit, and no new hard-model application is proved.

## Findings and evidence

* **Internally gated proof:** [ADDITIVE_PAIR_REPLICATION_LEMMA.md](../../../notes/metric_acquisition/cycle19/ADDITIVE_PAIR_REPLICATION_LEMMA.md). Independent gate: [ADDITIVE_REPLICA_GATE.md](../../../notes/root_cycle19/ADDITIVE_REPLICA_GATE.md). The last/penultimate ordered ANOVA assignment charges every residual interaction at most once, even when pairs share slots. Reversibility, exact mathematical stationarity, acquired bottom sampling, initial stationary-mass/warm-start bounds and finite-bit coupling costs are explicit.
* **Exact control:** [REPLICATION_PRIMITIVE_CHECK.json](REPLICATION_PRIMITIVE_CHECK.json). The pair simultaneous-flip kernel is reducible with full gap zero; the q=8 refreshed replica chain has exact gap1/18, exceeding the bound1/192. The deliberately wrong all-other-slots residual context assigns one interaction four times. There were2325 exact assertions,0.0318652 seconds and434,997 peak traced Python bytes. This does not run the matching FPRAS.
* **Acquisition obstruction:** [REPLICATION_FIELD_BARRIER.md](../../../notes/metric_acquisition/cycle19/REPLICATION_FIELD_BARRIER.md). For biased Bernoulli p<=1/2, simultaneous-flip Metropolis has optimal all-additive C=1/(4p), proved by an exact completed square. Identical adjacent laws therefore do not guarantee a polynomial C. At p=2^-b the replica requirement is exponential in encoded b, while an equally informed exact sampler uses b fair bits. Its direct four-state rational replay passes527 assertions in0.0121190 seconds,10
